sql: SELECT y.trip_date, w.prcp_mm, w.snow_mm, w.tmax_c, w.tmin_c FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-27') ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
